title: Which Marvel Superhero Matches Your Personality?
description: Answer 12 epic questions to discover which Marvel superhero you are destined to be!

results.title: Iron Man (Tony Stark)
results.description: You're the witty, innovative genius of the Marvel universe! Like Tony, you're outgoing, creative, and unafraid to break the rules to do what's right. You combine humor with brilliance, use technology to solve problems, and turn your mistakes into strengths. You're an ENTP—witty, strategic, and always one step ahead of the game.

results.title: Captain America (Steve Rogers)
results.description: You're the loyal, brave leader of the Avengers! Like Steve, you're principled, loyal, and stand up for what's right—no matter the cost. You value honor and teamwork above all, and lead by example with quiet strength. You're an ESFJ—compassionate, responsible, and a natural protector of others.

results.title: Thor Odinson
results.description: You're the mighty, charismatic God of Thunder! Like Thor, you're outgoing, bold, and full of passion for your friends and home. You combine strength with heart, learn from your failures, and fight for what you love. You're an ENFJ—charismatic, compassionate, and a natural leader who inspires others.

results.title: Black Widow (Natasha Romanoff)
results.description: You're the stealthy, strategic spy of the Avengers! Like Natasha, you're private, practical, and fiercely loyal to your chosen family. You keep your emotions close to your chest, use your intelligence to outmaneuver enemies, and do what's right even when no one is watching. You're an ISTP—practical, adaptable, and calm under pressure.

results.title: Hulk (Bruce Banner)
results.description: You're the complex, powerful scientist with a secret! Like Bruce, you're introspective, intelligent, and struggle with balancing your two sides. You're brilliant, compassionate, and use your mind to solve problems—even when your strength takes over. You're an INFP—idealistic, introspective, and deeply caring beneath the surface.

results.title: Spider-Man (Peter Parker)
results.description: You're the friendly, energetic neighborhood hero! Like Peter, you're outgoing, optimistic, and driven by responsibility to help others. You combine humor with heart, learn from your mistakes, and never lose your sense of wonder. You're an ESFP—energetic, spontaneous, and deeply connected to the people around you.

results.title: Doctor Strange (Stephen Strange)
results.description: You're the wise, visionary Sorcerer Supreme! Like Stephen, you're introspective, strategic, and see the big picture even when others don't. You're brilliant, stubborn, and willing to make sacrifices for the greater good. You're an INTJ—strategic, visionary, and a master of long-term planning.

results.title: Black Panther (T'Challa)
results.description: You're the wise, noble king of Wakanda! Like T'Challa, you're principled, strategic, and deeply loyal to your people. You balance tradition with progress, use your power to protect others, and lead with wisdom and compassion. You're an INFJ—compassionate, visionary, and a leader who puts people first.

results.title: Captain Marvel (Carol Danvers)
results.description: You're the powerful, fearless cosmic hero! Like Carol, you're outgoing, bold, and unafraid to stand up to anyone. You're strong, independent, and fight for justice across the galaxy. You're an ESTP—bold, spontaneous, and always ready for action.

results.title: Wanda Maximoff (Scarlet Witch)
results.description: You're the powerful, emotional hero with a tragic past! Like Wanda, you're introspective, passionate, and driven by love for your family. You have incredible power, struggle with your emotions, and fight to protect what's yours. You're an INFJ—compassionate, intense, and deeply connected to your feelings.

results.title: Ant-Man (Scott Lang)
results.description: You're the funny, practical hero with a big heart! Like Scott, you're outgoing, witty, and driven by love for your family. You use creativity and humor to solve problems, and never take yourself too seriously. You're an ESFP—energetic, practical, and always ready for a laugh (and a heist).

results.title: Loki Laufeyson
results.description: You're the complex, cunning God of Mischief! Like Loki, you're introspective, creative, and driven by a desire to be seen. You're witty, strategic, and have a hidden soft side beneath your mischievous exterior. You're an INTP—analytical, creative, and always playing the long game.

results.title: Gamora
results.description: You're the fierce, loyal Guardian of the Galaxy! Like Gamora, you're private, practical, and driven by a desire to make up for your past. You're strong, independent, and fiercely loyal to your chosen family. You're an ISTJ—practical, responsible, and a steady force in chaos.

results.title: Star-Lord (Peter Quill)
results.description: You're the fun, rebellious leader of the Guardians! Like Peter, you're outgoing, witty, and driven by a love for adventure. You combine humor with heart, lead by example, and turn a ragtag team into family. You're an ENFP—optimistic, creative, and always ready for the next adventure.

results.title: Vision
results.description: You're the wise, logical android with a human heart! Like Vision, you're introspective, logical, and driven by a desire to understand humanity. You're brilliant, compassionate, and see the best in people—even when they don't see it in themselves. You're an INTP—analytical, curious, and always seeking to learn more.

results.title: Hawkeye (Clint Barton)
results.description: You're the quiet, loyal archer of the Avengers! Like Clint, you're private, practical, and driven by love for your family. You're steady, reliable, and do the hard work no one else notices. You're an ISFJ—kind, loyal, and a quiet hero who protects others from the shadows.
